limits: Stopped one-dimensional finite-volume finite-Euler law; same-step agreement is not continuum DK convergence.
No particle-law equivalence, rare-event guarantee, temporal convergence order or learning-convergence theorem is established by these experiments.
Gradient derivative interchange and remaining stopping/time bias are unresolved.
Transport quadrature, finite-generator/Euler and stopping defects prevent a residual-only error certificate.
Natural validation rows share parents and were used for model selection; descriptive residual bins have no independent accuracy or significance claim.
Natural-pool reweighting cannot populate absent boundary strata; empty bins are unknown rather than evidence of zero error.
Fixed four-payoff bank and same-time covariance at three horizons; no arbitrary new observable, complete path or joint-time covariance capability.
Raw Gaussian is unstopped and approximate; exact geometry/consistency does not prove stopped-law accuracy.
R4 uses paid supervised future labels; differentiating only correction heads omits supplied ODE dependence.
Whole-family intervals are pointwise; consistent optimizer seeds do not establish simultaneous grid-wide inference.
Mean errors use reference SD and covariance errors use SD products, not relative errors of potentially zero moments.
Separate N-scaled physical covariance from physical covariance and solver/train-normalized residual units.
Accuracy-qualified neural cost advantage is not a required positive outcome; failed/unresolved gates remain explicit.
Historical scientific and software evidence stays scoped to its recorded source, workload and allocation.
